results.snippet: There is no minimum or maximum threshold to be considered as an MSB. Therefore if your company engages in the business of transferring funds — regardless of the amount — you must obtain a money transmitter license and renew it every two years.

results.title: Money Transmitter Licensing | Harbor Compliance
results.snippet: While money transmitter businesses are sometimes called money service businesses (MSB), not all service companies have transmitter capabilities. Acting as a transmitter requires transferring money within the United States or abroad on behalf of another person or persons. States differ on the definition of a money transmitter, so it can seem like a bit of a challenge to know if your specific business model requires a money transmitter license or not.
